title: Construction.
bodyText: The rights, liabilities, and remedies created by this chapter shall be construed to be in addition to and not in substitution, exclusion or displacement of other rights, liabilities, remedies provided by law.
bodyHtml: [§481F-9]  Construction.  The rights, liabilities, and remedies created by this chapter shall be construed to be in addition to and not in substitution, exclusion or displacement of other rights, liabilities, remedies provided by law. [L 1986, c 194, pt of §2]
